officialScore.label: Internal Engineering Quality Score
officialScore.disclaimer: MarketMonth Internal Engineering Quality Score against the project rubric only. Not industry-certified, independently certified, or externally validated.

externalBaseline.label: External Baseline Coverage

areas.label: TypeScript strictness and build integrity
areas.evidence: tsconfig strict check + npm run typecheck exit=0

areas.label: ESLint / static analysis
areas.evidence: eslint.config present; lint exit=0

areas.label: Automated testing with meaningful assertions
areas.evidence: npm test + 4 feature test files under src/

areas.label: Coverage tooling
areas.evidence: No dedicated coverage gate in package scripts

areas.label: Circular dependency detection
areas.evidence: In-repo import graph cycle detector (quality collector); not dependency-cruiser/madge

areas.label: Dead-code / unused-export analysis
areas.evidence: No Knip/ts-prune wired into CI

areas.label: Dependency vulnerability scanning
areas.evidence: npm run audit:deps (npm audit --audit-level=high) gated in knowledge-check CI

areas.label: Secret scanning
areas.evidence: Gitleaks (or equivalent) step in knowledge-check CI

areas.label: OWASP-oriented / Semgrep / CodeQL
areas.evidence: No Semgrep or CodeQL workflow

areas.label: Authentication and authorization boundaries
areas.evidence: Auth scaffold exists; CURRENT_STATE marks production auth gates incomplete — not fully verified by automated matrix

areas.label: Secure environment-variable handling
areas.evidence: .env.example + undocumented/NEXT_PUBLIC secret-name checks in rubric

areas.label: Accessibility testing
areas.evidence: No axe/pa11y/Playwright a11y gate

areas.label: Performance / bundle-size budgets
areas.evidence: No Lighthouse CI or bundle analyzer budget

areas.label: API contract validation
areas.evidence: Zod schemas for discovery requests/events; no OpenAPI contract suite

areas.label: Database migration discipline
areas.evidence: Drizzle present; no automated migration-drift gate in quality closeout

areas.label: Error handling and resilience
areas.evidence: Feature tests cover validation failures; no chaos/resilience suite

areas.label: Logging and observability
areas.evidence: CURRENT_STATE lists production observability as missing

areas.label: CI quality gates
areas.evidence: CI runs audit:deps, secret scan, typecheck, lint, test, knowledge:check, quality:check

areas.label: Supply-chain / dependency integrity
areas.evidence: Dependabot for npm + GitHub Actions (weekly); no SBOM/attestation gate yet

areas.label: Documentation and ownership
areas.evidence: ownership-rules.json + CURRENT_STATE freshness + FEATURES docs checks

areas.label: Architectural dependency enforcement
areas.evidence: Guardian + quality independence rules (UI/engine/db, public APIs)

externalBaseline.note: This is coverage of recognized engineering practices with executable evidence — not a certification and not merged into the Internal Engineering Quality Score.
